census.claim: the agent stated that the square is ABCD, treating the heptagon vertex B as if it were a square vertex, instead of recognizing from the diagram that B is a heptagon vertex and the square's labeled vertices are A, C, D and an unlabeled fourth vertex

the agent placed heptagon vertex B at angular direction 2*(360/7)=102.857 degrees from A, treating it as the second vertex counterclockwise from A, instead of placing B at the adjacent heptagon vertex on the other side of AD, where ray AB makes the 128.571-degree heptagon interior angle with AD
the agent placed the square vertex C at (1,1), directly above D, in the A=(0,0), D=(1,0) coordinate setup instead of placing the diagram's labeled C at (0,1), directly above A
the agent concluded that angle BAC is 405/7 degrees instead of the correct 270/7 degrees
the agent wrote |102.857 - 90| = 57.857 and |720/7 - 90| = 405/7 instead of computing the actual difference 12.857 = 90/7

certificates.rationale: Event_001 explicitly states 'The square is ABCD,' which treats heptagon vertex B as a square vertex. The diagram in the question labels B as a heptagon vertex and only labels A, C, D on the square, with the fourth square vertex unlabeled, so the statement contradicts the diagram evidence.

Event_013 and event_015 set angle_AB = 2*(360/7) = 102.857 degrees. In the cited diagram, B is the adjacent heptagon vertex on the other side of A from D; with AD horizontal, ray AB makes the regular-heptagon interior angle 900/7 = 128.571 degrees with AD, so the placement is incorrect.

Event_013 and event_015 place C = (1,1), described as directly above D for A=(0,0), D=(1,0). The diagram construction C = A + dir(90)*(F-A), with F labeled D, gives C=(0,1), directly above A, so the labeled C was placed at the unlabeled fourth square vertex instead.

Event_017 and event_019 conclude angle BAC = 405/7 degrees. From the diagram geometry, with C=(0,1) making ray AC vertical at 90 degrees and B at the adjacent heptagon vertex making ray AB at 900/7 = 128.571 degrees, the angle is 900/7 - 90 = 270/7 degrees, so the conclusion is incorrect.
Event_019 writes |102.857 - 90| = 57.857 and |720/7 - 90| = 405/7. The actual arithmetic difference is 720/7 - 630/7 = 90/7 = 12.857, so the claimed separation is wrong.
